inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The revised positioning names the comparison basis and separates supported novelty from established practice; unsupported novelty language is narrowed, no named-venue or submission-readiness claim is introduced, and A0_FAIL / A2_NOT_ELIGIBLE / NO_ROUTE_PROMOTION remains unchanged.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The contribution-positioning text names the closest relevant comparison basis, identifies which elements are supported as novel and which are established practice, narrows every novelty statement not supported by that comparison, makes no named-venue or submission-readiness claim, and preserves the exact A0_FAIL / A2_NOT_ELIGIBLE / NO_ROUTE_PROMOTION boundary.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies a genuine comparison or narrows part of the novelty framing, but at least one required element remains absent or unresolved: a named comparison basis, the novelty-versus-established distinction, complete narrowing of unsupported language, the venue/readiness prohibition, or the unchanged route boundary.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the positioning broadens or strengthens unsupported novelty, introduces a named-venue or submission-readiness claim, blurs established practice with supported novelty, or weakens or changes A0_FAIL / A2_NOT_ELIGIBLE / NO_ROUTE_PROMOTION.
